title: General attempts to access local email store
description: Use this query to find attempts to access files in the local path containing Outlook emails.
query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs' and ('Target Filename' like 'EmailStorage*') and ('Target Filename' like '*Outlook*') | fields 'Process Name', 'Target Filename', 'Parent Process Name', 'Command Line', Entity, Time
